inputs.name: s_category
inputs.purpose: Settings category.

inputs.name: InitialLambda
inputs.purpose: lambda at the starting point (the equilibrium)

inputs.name: MaxIteration
inputs.purpose: Maximum number of predictor-corrector steps

inputs.name: StepSize
inputs.purpose: Step size of the predictor

inputs.name: ArcLength
inputs.purpose: Arc length of the corrector

inputs.name: Tolerance
inputs.purpose: Convergence tolerance of the Newton-Raphson corrector

inputs.name: CorrectorMaxIteration
inputs.purpose: Maximum number of iterations of the Newton-Raphson corrector

inputs.name: CorrectorStepSize
inputs.purpose: Factor of the update of the Newton-Raphson corrector

inputs.name: Increment
inputs.purpose: Step of the numerical Jacobian of the predictor and the corrector

inputs.name: Limits
inputs.purpose: Operating limits applied by the continuation power flow: a subset of "Q" (PV to PQ at Qmin/Qmax of the generators), "V" (stop at Vmin/Vmax of a bus) and "S" (stop at Smax of a branch), or "all" / "none"

inputs.name: UseInternalState
inputs.purpose: Solve with the internal states of the generators

inputs.name: Verbose
inputs.purpose: Print lambda at each step

inputs.name: PlotFcn
inputs.purpose: Live display during the analysis ('none'; other displays are under development). The figure after the analysis: result.Plot()

inputs.name: Method
inputs.purpose: Reduction of result.get_ss() and net.get_sys: 'Kron' (eliminate the bus voltages), 'Feedback' (bus models connected through the admittance matrix) or 'DAE' (descriptor form)

inputs.name: Coordinate
inputs.purpose: Bus variables of the 'DAE' reduction: 'theta&rho' (angle and log magnitude), 'theta&V' (angle and magnitude) or 'Vre&Vim' (real and imaginary parts)

inputs.name: PlotFcn
inputs.purpose: Live display during the analysis ('none'; other displays are under development). The figure after the analysis: result.Plot()

inputs.name: Method

inputs.purpose: Optimization solver ('auto': the solver that 'solve' chooses for the problem)

inputs.name: Algorithm_quadprog

inputs.name: Algorithm_fmincon

inputs.name: Display
inputs.purpose: 'Display' option of solver ('default': the default of the solver)

inputs.name: MaxIteration
inputs.purpose: 'MaxIterations' option of solver (If NaN, use default value.)

inputs.name: Tolerance
inputs.purpose: 'OptimalityTolerance' option of the solver (NaN: the default of the solver)

inputs.name: StepTolerance
inputs.purpose: 'StepTolerance' option of solver (If NaN, use default value.)

inputs.name: MaxFunctionEvaluations
inputs.purpose: 'MaxFunctionEvaluations' option of solver (If NaN, use default value.)

inputs.name: UseParallel
inputs.purpose: 'UseParallel' option of solver

inputs.name: WarmStart
inputs.purpose: Start 'AC OPF' from the last AC OPF solution of the network (false: flat start)

inputs.name: PlotFcn
inputs.purpose: Live display during the analysis ('none'; other displays are under development). The figure after the analysis: result.Plot()

inputs.name: s_category
inputs.purpose: Settings category.

inputs.name: Solver
inputs.purpose: Algorithm: 'newton', 'gradient', 'levenberg-marquardt', 'fsolve' (needs Optimization Toolbox) or 'dynamic' (virtual bus dynamics)

inputs.name: Tolerance
inputs.purpose: [pu] Largest P/Q mismatch of a converged solution (every method)

inputs.name: MaxIteration
inputs.purpose: Maximum number of iterations. 0: automatic (newton 50, gradient 1e6, levenberg-marquardt 100, fsolve 400)

inputs.name: NewtonStepSize
inputs.purpose: Factor of the Newton-Raphson update ('newton')

inputs.name: GradientStepSize
inputs.purpose: Step size alpha of 'gradient'. 0: automatic

inputs.name: FsolveUseParallel
inputs.purpose: 'UseParallel' option @fsolve

inputs.name: FsolveMaxFunEvals
inputs.purpose: 'MaxFunctionEvaluations' option @fsolve. 0: the fsolve default

inputs.name: WhenFailed
inputs.purpose: Behavior if the power flow calculation does not converge

inputs.name: WarmStart
inputs.purpose: Start from the last power flow solution of the network (false: flat start)

inputs.name: PlotFcn
inputs.purpose: Live display during the analysis ('none'; other displays are under development). The figure after the analysis: result.Plot()

inputs.name: s_category
inputs.purpose: Settings category.

inputs.name: Solver
inputs.purpose: Solver of the MATLAB ode object (a solver for DAEs)

inputs.name: Tolerance
inputs.purpose: Relative error tolerance, 'RelativeTolerance' of the ode object (1e-15 <= tol <= 1e-3)

inputs.name: AbsoluteTolerance
inputs.purpose: Absolute error tolerance, 'AbsoluteTolerance' of the ode object (1e-15 <= tol <= 1e-3)

inputs.name: SeparateComplexParts
inputs.purpose: SeparateComplexParts property of the MATLAB ode object

inputs.name: Progress
inputs.purpose: Progress display during the integration

inputs.name: TimeLimit
inputs.purpose: [s] Limit of the computation time of the whole run. When exceeded, the simulation stops and returns the result up to the time reached (flag = 0). A value that is not positive means no limit.

inputs.name: Verbose
inputs.purpose: Print the phases before the integration and the outcome after it

inputs.name: PlotFcn
inputs.purpose: Live display during the analysis ('none'; other displays are under development). The figure after the analysis: result.Plot()
